pageDescription: Debug and demo three access modes of Centag, helping you configure Base URL and API Key in Agent tools like Cursor and CLI.
recommendedHint: No client modification needed, compatible with OpenAI / Anthropic standard protocol
tooltipDefault: Use system default pipeline, client only needs to configure Base URL and API Key
tooltipKeyword: Add keyword at the beginning of message to select pipeline, flexible and no code changes needed
advancedHint: Model name mode only needs config change; header mode requires code changes
tooltipModel: Use pipeline.<id> in the model field to specify pipeline
tooltipHeader: Specify via X-Proxy-Mode and other headers, requires client to support custom headers
defaultExplain: No request protocol modification, uses standard /v1/chat/completions. Automatically uses system default pipeline when no pipeline is specified.
clientExampleModel: Model: auto  (or leave empty, parsed by server)
keywordExplain: Add keyword at the beginning of user message content (built-in #d or pipeline custom shortcut), server automatically routes to the corresponding pipeline.
modelExplain: Keep OpenAI standard headers (Authorization, etc.), fill pipeline.<PipelineID> in the request body model field; backend and model are configured by pipeline nodes.
headerExplain: Specify pipeline strategy via X-Pipeline-ID request header, use auto for request body model. Requires client to support custom HTTP headers.
pipelineFormHint: Backend and model are configured by pipeline nodes, no need to specify here.
headerFieldLabel: Private request header to be sent:
keywordHint: Click keyword to insert at the beginning of input. Keywords are sent as-is, parsed by server to route to the corresponding pipeline.
temperatureTip: Controls the randomness of model output (approximately 0~2, lower is more stable). Only applies to this conversation request.
httpModelExample: Model Name Mode Request Example (Standard Headers)
httpPreviewHint: No need to add Centag private headers; fill pipeline.<PipelineID> in the request body model field, server middleware parses and routes internally.
keywordGuideDesc: Add keyword at the beginning of message to specify proxy mode, format: keyword + space + message content
actualSend: Actual Send (keyword sent as-is, auto-parsed by server):
exampleHint: (Server recognizes #c and switches to intent classification mode)
emptyHintDefault: Send a message directly, it will be processed by the system default pipeline (no keyword or special model needed)
emptyHintKeyword: Add keyword (e.g. #d) at the beginning of message to switch pipeline, or leave empty for default pipeline
emptyHintModel: When sending a message, model field {model} will be used, model is configured by pipeline nodes
emptyHintHeader: Select pipeline then send, strategy will be specified via X-Pipeline-ID header, model uses auto
emptyHint: Enter a message to start demo
placeholderKeyword: Enter message, add keyword at beginning (e.g. #d hello)
placeholderModel: Enter message, pipeline will be specified via model field
noModelReply: No model response received, the backend may have returned an abnormal format or no content.
noModelReplyHint: No model response content received. Please check if the stream response was truncated by proxy, or try disabling 'Stream Output' and retry.
